# Plith

> A modern Windows audio OSD (on-screen display) that replaces the aging Windows volume flyout. Voicemeeter-first design with integrated media controls, mixer-agnostic endpoint pinning, and Game mode over exclusive fullscreen.

Plith is a free, open-source Windows 10/11 application written in WPF + .NET 10. It surfaces audio volume changes, Voicemeeter bus levels, and now-playing media (Spotify, YouTube in browsers, etc.) via a rounded card overlay that works over fullscreen games. MIT licensed. Repository: https://github.com/berkeerdo/Plith

## Core

- [Homepage](https://plith.app): Product landing page with download, features, FAQ.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/berkeerdo/Plith): Source code, releases, issues.
- [Latest Release](https://github.com/berkeerdo/Plith/releases/latest): Installer download and release notes.
- [License (MIT)](https://github.com/berkeerdo/Plith/blob/main/LICENSE): Free to use, modify, redistribute.

## Features

- Voicemeeter-first: reads any Voicemeeter bus (0-31) via `VoicemeeterRemote64.dll` P/Invoke.
- Windows Core Audio fallback via NAudio when Voicemeeter is not running.
- Mixer-agnostic endpoint pinning for SteelSeries Sonar, Rode Unify, Elgato Wave Link, VB-Cable, etc.
- SMTC media integration (album art, title, artist, transport controls) for Spotify, YouTube (any Chromium browser), Twitch web, Windows media apps.
- Game mode: UIAccess-signed BandWindow draws above exclusive fullscreen games.
- Configurable summon hotkey, auto-start on Windows login, live theme following.
- Passive overlay: no game memory access, no input injection, documented Windows APIs only.
